clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau always checked the label before the price. Homogenized milk has every molecule broken down so it can sit on a shelf for three weeks instead of souring in two days.

His fix: buy milk or cheese labeled "raw" or "non-homogenized." Raw means two things - not homogenized, not pasteurized - closer to what your grandparents drank. It isn't always easy to find, and that's okay.

Next time you're at the store, flip the carton over and look for that one word.

Kevin Trudeau says McDonald's fries used to be cooked in beef fat - by most accounts the best-tasting fries you could buy.

Then saturated fat got blamed for heart problems, and the companies selling hydrogenated vegetable oil benefited most from that panic, in his view. McDonald's switched to vegetable oil, and fast food never tasted quite the same again.

The oil used is usually printed right on the menu board or nutrition page - worth a quick look.

clips.start_words: The largest organ in the body
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau points to something most people never think about: the skin is the body's largest organ, and whatever touches it gets absorbed - including shower, bath or pool water.

If that water carries chlorine, his view is a long shower puts more of it into your body than a glass of tap water would.

City water needs chlorine to kill bacteria before it reaches your home - that part is smart. The swap he uses: a shower filter, or a salt-water pool instead of a chlorinated one.

#kevintrudeau #chlorinefree #skinhealth #waterfilter #healthyhome #cleanwater

Kevin Trudeau tells a story about the old milkman route: milk used to separate on the shelf, and after about 48 hours it would turn sour. That's why deliveries came two or three times a week.

Then one food scientist found a fix: break every molecule down to the same tiny size - homogenize it - and there's nothing left to spoil. Shelf life jumped from two days to three weeks overnight.

It's clever, and it's also why the carton in your fridge barely resembles the milk your grandparents drank.
